response.query: Which explicit aggregation rule will we adopt to translate LA spot‑to‑spot heterogeneity into object‑level likelihoods in the hierarchical Bayesian model?
response.answer: We will adopt the maximum a posteriori (MAP) aggregation rule to translate LA spot-to-spot heterogeneity into object-level likelihoods in the hierarchical Bayesian model.
